description: This file defines API endpoints for a chat system, including message listing, creation, answering questions with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and semantic search. It uses FastAPI for HTTP routing, Supabase for data storage, and external services for moderation, retrieval, and answer generation.

methods.name: get_supabase()
methods.description: Initializes and returns a Supabase client using environment variables.

methods.name: list_messages(session_id: str = Path(..., description="Session ID"), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists messages in a session for the current user, with ownership validation.

methods.name: create_message(session_id: str, payload: MessageCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new user message in a session after moderation and quota checks.

methods.name: answer_question(session_id: str, payload: AnswerRequest, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles user questions by moderating input, querying embeddings, and generating an answer with Gemini, then saving the assistant response.

methods.name: semantic_search(session_id: str, payload: SearchRequest, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Performs semantic search within session corpus using vector embeddings.
